auth.faqWhyQ: Why do I need to pay $7.95/month?
auth.faqWhyA: The Speakeasy is built to be the best place to meet, match, and craft together. Your membership unlocks dedicated video lounges, the Match Maker, the matching calendar, and priority events. Cancel anytime in one click — no trailing charges.
auth.faqSwitchQ: Can I switch or cancel my plan?
auth.faqSwitchA: Yes. Once you're signed in, go to Account → Membership to switch or cancel your subscription at any time.
auth.faqPromoA: $7.95/month is the promotional early-bird rate for the Hooking Up plan. The standard rate is $17.95/month, so lock it in while the promotion lasts.
auth.faqMovingQ: What do I get with Moving In?
auth.faqMovingA: Moving In is the global host membership: create lounges and groups, host parties, and get featured up front. It's $17.95/month or $179.50/year.
